findings.highlight: The heat radiating from my shoulder
findings.evidenceJa: 肩の付け根から侵入する熱
findings.governingReading: Heat invades Shirou through the base of his shoulder.
findings.explanation: “Radiating from” reverses the inward motion and makes the shoulder a source of heat.

findings.highlight: realize that I’ve been scorched black
findings.evidenceJa: 気を抜けばいつのまにか真っ黒焦げになっている
findings.governingReading: If his attention lapses, he imagines he will find himself charred black before he knows it.
findings.explanation: The English turns a conditional threat into completed injury and invents a moment of realization.

findings.highlight: the entrancethe hole to let them out
findings.evidenceJa: 連中を外に出すべき穴
findings.governingReading: The opening that should let the intruders back out is sealed with foreign flesh.
findings.explanation: The English contains a fused draft fragment that breaks the sentence.

findings.highlight: a blacksmith heroic spirit
findings.evidenceJa: 鍛冶を生業とする英霊
findings.governingReading: He identifies Archer as a Heroic Spirit whose trade was smithing.
findings.explanation: The English noun pile is malformed and obscures the occupational parallel.

findings.highlight: duplicates everything he sees and understands
findings.evidenceJa: いくらでも複製する
findings.governingReading: He can reproduce any number of things he has seen and understood.
findings.explanation: The English retains the eligibility condition but drops the unlimited quantity.

findings.highlight: destroy the regularity
findings.evidenceJa: 秩序を乱してはいけない
findings.governingReading: He insists that order must not be disturbed.
findings.explanation: “Destroy the regularity” is non-English and changes order into regularity.

findings.highlight: Hugging me, she buries her face in my chest
findings.evidenceJa: ばふ、と頭からこっちの胸に飛び込んできて
findings.governingReading: Illya flies headfirst into his chest with a soft impact.
findings.explanation: The English replaces her full rushing action and its sound with a settled hug.

findings.highlight: I can’t do anything if she’s crying like this
findings.evidenceJa: 泣きつかれたら大人しくしているしかない
findings.governingReading: With Illya clinging to him in tears, Shirou feels he can only stay quietly still.
findings.explanation: The English drops her clinging and his specific response.

findings.highlight: As I speak
findings.evidenceJa: してくれ、と言いかけて
findings.governingReading: Shirou is cut off just as he begins to ask Illya for an explanation.
findings.explanation: The English makes the speech already ongoing and deletes what he was about to request.

findings.highlight: repress your left arm
findings.evidenceJa: 左腕を抑えつける
findings.governingReading: Illya tells Shirou to pin down or restrain the left arm instead of merely enduring the pain.
findings.explanation: “Repress” is an abstract psychological verb and obscures the physical instruction.

findings.highlight: if I know the origin of the pain
findings.evidenceJa: 異物がなんであるか判れば
findings.governingReading: Control becomes possible once Shirou identifies what the foreign element is.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the identity of the foreign substance with the pain’s origin.

findings.highlight: big hospital clothes
findings.evidenceJa: だぼだぼの病人服
findings.governingReading: He has been dressed in baggy patient’s clothing.
findings.explanation: “Big hospital clothes” is unnatural and loses the garment’s looseness and patient-specific role.

findings.highlight: removes the coverings
findings.evidenceJa: あっさりと俺を裸にした
findings.governingReading: Kirei casually unfastens the restraint belts and strips Shirou naked.
findings.explanation: The English sanitizes the completed exposure into removing unspecified coverings.

findings.highlight: Archer has been eliminated
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーが、消滅した
findings.governingReading: Archer has vanished from the world after enduring through the completed transplant.
findings.explanation: “Eliminated” suggests that another party defeated or removed him.

findings.highlight: a part of a heroic spirit
findings.evidenceJa: 現世に受肉させている英霊の肉
findings.governingReading: Archer’s severed flesh is incarnated and sustained in the present world by Shirou’s magical energy.
findings.explanation: The English keeps persistence but omits incarnation as flesh.

findings.highlight: You two would have died
findings.evidenceJa: おまえもアーチャーも長くはなかった
findings.governingReading: Neither Shirou nor Archer had long to live in their respective conditions.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the limited remaining duration.

findings.highlight: only succeeded in shape
findings.evidenceJa: 形だけ成功した後で
findings.governingReading: Kirei expected the joining to succeed only in outward form before shock killed Shirou.
findings.explanation: “Succeeded in shape” is malformed and obscures the distinction between physical joining and soul restoration.

findings.highlight: he would pull through if the connection was made
findings.evidenceJa: この二人なら、繋がりさえすれば持ち直す
findings.governingReading: Illya identifies Shirou and Archer as a special pair whose connection permits recovery.
findings.explanation: The English changes the pair into a singular “he,” obscuring reciprocal compatibility.

findings.highlight: a lump of dead meat
findings.evidenceJa: ただの塊
findings.governingReading: The arm is merely an insensate mass despite being attached.
findings.explanation: The English invents dead flesh, contradicting the explanation that Shirou’s energy sustains it as his living body.

findings.highlight: a hand numbed
findings.evidenceJa: 麻痺した腕
findings.governingReading: The sensation resembles an arm numbed after its circulation is cut off.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the affected limb from arm to hand.

findings.highlight: It shall familiarize with your body
findings.evidenceJa: 数日経てば馴染む
findings.governingReading: Kirei predicts that the joined arm will adapt to Shirou after several days.
findings.explanation: The English uses “familiarize” in an ungrammatical intransitive construction.

findings.highlight: the Shroud of Martin
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力殺しの聖骸布
findings.governingReading: The shroud suppresses magical energy itself, which is why it restrains activation and invasion.
findings.explanation: The English gives only a name and drops the stated functional property.

findings.highlight: fail and be consumed
findings.evidenceJa: 成れずに自滅するか
findings.governingReading: If he fails to mature enough, the imbalance will make him destroy himself.
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou’s self-destruction and makes him a passive victim.

findings.highlight: I can’t move my left hand
findings.evidenceJa: 左腕は動かない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot move the transplanted left arm.
findings.explanation: The English again narrows arm-wide immobility to the hand.

findings.highlight: I just drape it over my shoulder
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず羽織っただけ
findings.governingReading: Because the arm cannot move, Shirou merely drapes the jacket around himself without properly putting it on.
findings.explanation: The English invents a single-shoulder placement.

findings.highlight: stay in your mansion
findings.evidenceJa: 屋敷に立て篭もり
findings.governingReading: Kirei recommends barricading themselves inside the mansion until the war ends.
findings.explanation: The English removes the defensive fortification.

findings.highlight: one other who shamelessly stayed on the battlefield
findings.evidenceJa: のこのこ死地に赴いた者
findings.governingReading: Kirei needles Rin by recalling someone who blithely went out to a place of death after losing his Servant.
findings.explanation: The English changes movement into continued presence, death ground into a battlefield, and foolish nonchalance into shame.

findings.highlight: Matou Zouken is a weak person
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐臓硯は小物
findings.governingReading: Kirei calls Zouken a petty or small-caliber villain despite the hopeless power disparity.
findings.explanation: “Weak person” changes contempt for his caliber into generic weakness.

findings.highlight: I am sure you can devise some plan
findings.evidenceJa: 何らかの策はあるだろう
findings.governingReading: Kirei reasons that there may be some stratagem against a petty opponent.
findings.explanation: The English invents confidence that Shirou and Rin themselves can devise one.

findings.highlight: I stare at Tohsaka because I don’t understand
findings.evidenceJa: 視線だけで遠坂に問いただす
findings.governingReading: Shirou uses only his gaze to press Rin for an explanation.
findings.explanation: The English removes the nonverbal question and makes the gaze merely a symptom of confusion.

findings.highlight: she looks like she doesn’t want to interfere
findings.evidenceJa: こっちに振るなって顔
findings.governingReading: Rin’s face tells Shirou not to hand the awkward question over to her.
findings.explanation: The English changes refusal to be put on the spot into a general wish not to interfere.

findings.highlight: Even if she goes back to her castle
findings.evidenceJa: このまま城に戻しては
findings.governingReading: Kirei warns that sending Illya back to the castle would simply deliver her to Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English removes the custodial agency and makes the return Illya’s independent act.

findings.highlight: I’m sorry
findings.evidenceJa: お断りするわ
findings.governingReading: Illya completes the rapid three-way refusal pattern with her own emphatic rejection.
findings.explanation: The English turns the repeated comic formula into an apology.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka calmly criticizes Illya
findings.evidenceJa: 実に冷淡にイリヤを責め立てる
findings.governingReading: Rin presses Illya with conspicuous coldness as part of a deliberate provocation.
findings.explanation: The English replaces forceful, cold interrogation with mild calm criticism, obscuring the maneuver.
